description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
As the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Ygra's second ability and Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger, creating a tapped Treasure token. The Treasure will enter as a 7/7 Dinosaur Food in addition to its types due to Displaced Dinosaurs and Ygra.
When the Treasure enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
